about: P03 build step 2a (ADR 0029): the defect-family pattern per script and the held-out draw, committed BEFORE any defect is written or any reviewer reads the set.
why_two_patterns: 36 slots at 9 lint-visible / 18 logic / 9 blast-radius = 9 mixed scripts (9/9/9) + 3 all-logic scripts (0/9/0). Drawing 3 mixed + 1 all-logic for held-out gives exactly 3/6/3 there - the same proportions as the whole set. The all-logic scripts are the three that change nothing on the machine (a report and two exports/checks), where a blast-radius defect would be contrived.

draw.method: python random.Random(seed): sorted(rng.sample(mixed, 3)), then rng.sample(all_logic, 1); mixed and all_logic listed in script-number order
draw.seed_source: int('af9c31e', 16) - the build step 1 commit, fixed before the draw, so neither Jose nor Claude chose which scripts are held out
